verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets an in-product Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent that auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates high-risk or complex cases for human review, so agent-driven match review is a documented first-party capability. A case audit trail endpoint exists, but nothing shows the agent records its rationale for each decision, and the agent evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented agent-recorded rationale per match decision, technical docs on how the agent reviews hits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
